scope: benchmark tools, sample configs, protocol tests and GPU handoff only; no runtime optimization or default change

CUDA_compile.reason: no available GPU/CUDA runtime dependencies on implementation host

real_tokenizer_chat_boundary.reason: CPU template fixture only; real local tokenizer must be inspected on GPU host

limitations: CPU fixtures, HTTP test streams and mocks do not establish GPU correctness or throughput.
GPU replay is transport-only with real pack payload/layout; no MoE compute, CUDA graph or scheduler overlap.
Model cache statistics are periodic snapshots with explicit alignment gaps, not exact request deltas.
TTFT/TPOT use client receipt timestamps; coalesced token chunks limit resolution.
Frozen answer TTFT includes prefill, first decode token and client overhead, not pure prefill compute.
Sample startup profile must be confirmed; startup warmup makes process-restart expert cache nonempty.
Real route capture is a separate profiling step; raw capture may include startup warmup and cap truncation, with incomplete sweeps rejected.
Checkpoint identity uses declared revision, JSON hashes and file size/mtime signatures; full pack payload is hashed, full model weights are not.
Candidate profiles remain diagnostic and unapproved. Validated selection/loading is stage E.
Five rounds and provisional 3% gates require noise calibration and review before stage B.
